part.text: All tests pass. Let me verify the original reproduction case and edge cases with a quick standalone check:

Fixed. The bug was in `formatter<group_digits_view<T>>::format` (include/fmt/format.h:4152), which cast the value directly to unsigned, turning negative values into their two's-complement equivalents. It now uses `detail::make_write_int_arg` to compute the absolute value and sign prefix, same as the rest of the integer formatting path — this also makes `{:+}` signs work and handles the width correctly for negatives (`include/fmt/format.h:4151-4156`).

Verified:
- `format("{}", fmt::group_digits(-12345))` → `-12,345`
- Edge cases pass: `{:+}`, width padding, `uint64` max, and `INT64_MIN`
- Full test suite passes (20/20 ctest suites, including `group_digits_view` with negative-value cases)
